experiment.name: Human CRP sandwich ELISA (demo)
experiment.sample_matrix_note: Kit validated for cell culture supernates; serum/plasma require diluent optimisation (ref_01)

reagents.name: Reagent Diluent
reagents.composition: 1% BSA in PBS, pH 7.2–7.4, 0.2 µm filtered

reagents.name: Block Buffer
reagents.composition: 1% BSA in PBS, pH 7.2–7.4, 0.2 µm filtered

steps.name: Coat capture antibody
steps.note: Incubate overnight (no duration in minutes given). Capture antibody diluted in PBS without carrier protein; plate sealed during incubation.

steps.name: Block
steps.note: At least 1 hour. Wash count/volume assumed to match step_01 per the general protocol.

steps.name: Add samples and standards
steps.note: Samples/standards in Reagent Diluent; plate covered with adhesive strip. Wash count/volume assumed to match step_01 per the general protocol.

steps.name: Detection antibody
steps.note: Diluted in Reagent Diluent; new adhesive strip. Wash count/volume assumed to match step_01 per the general protocol.

steps.name: Streptavidin-HRP
steps.note: Protected from direct light. Wash count/volume assumed to match step_01 per the general protocol.

steps.name: Substrate (TMB)
steps.note: Protected from direct light. No wash before stop.

steps.name: Stop
steps.note: Mix gently. Datasheet (ref_01) volumes used; product page (ref_02) states 50 µL methanesulfonic acid — sources disagree.

steps.name: Read plate
steps.note: Read immediately after stop solution. If correction unavailable, subtract 540/570 nm reading from 450 nm reading; uncorrected 450 nm readings may be higher and less accurate (ref_02).

constraints.rule: No bubbles in any well before reading
constraints.rationale: Bubbles affect the optical reading and increase variability between replicates; remove before reading.

constraints.rule: Sample/standard incubation 2 hours at room temperature
constraints.rationale: Incorrect incubation times or temperatures are listed causes of a poor standard curve and low colour development.
constraints.note: tolerance_min to be set by team scientist before scientific_cases.json is written.

constraints.rule: Protect plate from direct light during Streptavidin-HRP and substrate incubations
constraints.rationale: The protocol specifies protection from direct light for these incubations.
constraints.note: Underlying mechanism not stated in the cited sources.

constraints.rule: Read plate immediately after adding stop solution
constraints.rationale: Delay in reading the plate is a listed cause of inaccurate colorimetric results.
constraints.note: Sources say 'immediately' without a numeric limit; max_allowed to be set by team scientist.

constraints.rule: Duplicate wells should agree with CV below 15%
constraints.rationale: High CV between duplicates indicates inconsistent results; bubbles and uneven washing are listed causes.
constraints.note: Source frames <15% as a target to aim for, not a hard kit specification.

constraints.rule: Wash 3 x 400 µL Wash Buffer with complete removal of liquid
constraints.rationale: Incomplete washing/aspiration is a listed cause of poor standard curve and poor precision; complete removal of liquid at each step is essential.
constraints.note: 3 x 400 µL stated for step_01; assumed for steps 02–05 per the general protocol.
